opening.argument: The presentation promotes paid OneCoin packages as a route to mining tokens and highly favorable returns, including the assurance that "You cannot fail to make money." It further presents a possible portfolio value of "up to or maybe more 300,000 Euros" after a year, encouraging participation through an unusually optimistic appreciation claim. The solicitation then extends beyond purchasing packages: viewers are told that "if you want to build a network it's a really simple thing," and that "every time you sponsor someone, whatever package they buy, you make 10%." The visible package slide lists paid tiers from EUR 100 to EUR 5,000 with token allocations and education levels. Together, these features tie potential earnings to both package purchases and recruitment-dependent commissions.
